phasing_details.phase_detail: single phase (to be complete any time within approved condition period)

description: Installation of 1No. BT Street Hub Unit and associated advertisement panels on either side of the unit
decision_conditions: <p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">The minimum display time for each advertisement shall be 10 seconds, the use of message sequencing for the same product is prohibited and the advertisements shall not include features/equipment which would allow interactive messages/advertisements to be displayed.&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; Reason: to ensure the safety of road users</span></p>

<p>Illumination for the proposed sign must remain below the limit set out in the Institute of Lighting Professionals (ILP) publication: “The Brightness of Illuminated Advertisements including digital displays” (PLG05/23, 2023). For lighting during the day, either no lighting, or maximum lighting levels (such as for digital displays) are set in accord with nighttime maximums or controlled, so they comply with the guidance approach to ambient lighting.&nbsp;</p><p>REASON: To safeguard amenity.</p>
